description:
Free. For a business on WooCommerce or Shopify (its card says `platform`), with no owner connection:
puts the offering in a cart session of OUR OWN on the shop’s public cart, gives it the delivery address and
reads back what the shop itself computes — `delivery.state` confirmed | refuted | unknown for that address,
`options` (each delivery / pickup with its price, tax and the whole order’s `total`), `tax`, `total`,
`currency`, and `delivery_date` ONLY when the shop publishes one in its standard fields (otherwise
`unknown` — ask the shop). Nothing is ordered, the cart is emptied afterwards, and only the address is
sent (no name, e-mail or phone; nothing is stored). Shopify’s public cart has no tax: `tax.state` is unknown
and the total is before tax. A shop whose cart is closed answers `not_available` with the reason; so does
any other platform. When the shop needs more of the address than you gave, `status: needs_address` names
the `missing` fields. A required add-on the page asks for («a card with a message?») is answered «no»
unless you pass `options`; `options_used` says what was chosen. Hand `order_url` to the user to buy.

address_1.description: street line, only for the price: some shops price by it

state.description: two letters; read from the postcode when omitted

deliver_to.description: where it must be brought: "33139", "Miami Beach, FL 33139", or {postcode, state, city, address_1}

items.description: several different items of the SAME shop in one cart (delivery and tax on the whole order); offering_id is then the first of them

offering_id.description: the offering id from a card

field.description: words of the page’s own question, e.g. «card»

value.description: the answer, e.g. «No», or the card message

options.description: answers to the product page’s own add-on questions; the rest are answered «no»

variant_id.description: a variant id from the card when it lists several

name: quote_order
title: What an order would cost delivered to an address — asked of the shop’s own cart, nothing ordered
